title.zh-CN: 持续发热咳嗽与血痰 · 68岁女性
title.en: Persistent fever, cough and blood-streaked sputum · woman aged 68

summary.zh-CN: 肺部症状经抗感染后未缓解，随后出现肾脏线索；需比较感染与肺肾系统性病变。
summary.en: Pulmonary symptoms persist despite antimicrobial treatment, followed by renal clues; compare infection with a systemic pulmonary–renal process.

provenance.license: Educational paraphrase; the source publication retains its copyright.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

reviewers: AI-assisted editorial source and guidance check; not a licensed clinician
guidelines: KDIGO. 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for ANCA-associated vasculitis, with amendments. https://kdigo.org/guidelines/antineutrophilic-cytoplasmic-antibody-anca-associated-vasculitis-aav/

notes.zh-CN: 已对照所列权威资料进行人工智能辅助编辑核对；未由执业医师审核。原报告罕见表现及方案仍需专科确认。
notes.en: AI-assisted editorial check against the cited authorities, not licensed-clinician review. Rare presentations and source regimens still require specialist confirmation.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

prompt.zh-CN: 肺部与尿液证据如何改变诊断方向？
prompt.en: How should lung and urine evidence change the diagnostic direction?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 考虑肺肾综合征和小血管炎，同时继续排查感染
text.en: Consider a pulmonary–renal syndrome and small-vessel vasculitis while continuing infection assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 血痰、贫血、尿异常及肌酐升高不能仅由肺部影像解释。
feedback.en: Blood-streaked sputum, anaemia, urinary changes and rising creatinine require an explanation beyond lung imaging alone.

text.zh-CN: 初次ANCA阴性即可排除小血管炎
text.en: An initially negative ANCA excludes small-vessel vasculitis

feedback.zh-CN: 阴性血清学不能独自推翻多系统证据，应结合动态评估。
feedback.en: Negative serology alone cannot negate multi-system evidence and requires contextual reassessment.

text.zh-CN: 午后低热足以固定为结核诊断
text.en: Afternoon low fever fixes the diagnosis as tuberculosis

feedback.zh-CN: 症状非特异且抗结核未改善，需要重新整合肾脏及血液证据。
feedback.en: The symptom is non-specific and treatment failed to help, requiring reintegration of renal and blood findings.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 后续pANCA支持临床方向，但不等同MPO确证或组织学结果
text.en: Later pANCA supports the clinical direction but is not MPO confirmation or histology

feedback.zh-CN: 滴度、抗原特异性和组织病理是不同证据层级。
feedback.en: Titre, antigen specificity and histology are distinct evidence types.

text.zh-CN: 可把治疗有效写成肾活检已确诊
text.en: Treatment response can be recorded as biopsy confirmation

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告因风险未活检，不能虚构病理。
feedback.en: Biopsy was not performed because of risk; pathology cannot be invented.

text.zh-CN: 多次培养阴性彻底排除一切感染
text.en: Repeated negative cultures exclude every infection

feedback.zh-CN: 取材、既往治疗和检测范围仍限制阴性结果。
feedback.en: Sampling, prior therapy and testing scope still limit negative findings.

prompt.zh-CN: 当活检风险高时，应怎样处理诊断与治疗安全？
prompt.en: When biopsy risk is high, how should diagnosis and treatment safety be handled?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 多学科权衡器官威胁、取材风险及感染可能，明确临床诊断的限制并制定监测方案
text.en: Balance organ threat, biopsy risk and infection in a multidisciplinary plan, explicitly stating limits of the clinical diagnosis and monitoring

feedback.zh-CN: 原报告以临床证据诊断，不能改写成病理确诊；延误和免疫抑制风险均需评估。
feedback.en: The report used clinical evidence, not pathological confirmation; both delay and immunosuppression risks require assessment.

text.zh-CN: 未有活检就永久拒绝系统性病因评估
text.en: Permanently reject systemic assessment without a biopsy

feedback.zh-CN: 取材不可行不等于不能综合临床证据，尤其在器官威胁时。
feedback.en: Infeasible biopsy does not prevent integrated clinical assessment, especially with threatened organs.

text.zh-CN: 仅按ANCA滴度决定全部治疗，不看器官状态
text.en: Base all treatment solely on ANCA titres

feedback.zh-CN: 血清滴度不是器官损伤、感染与毒性的替代指标。
feedback.en: Serological titres do not replace assessment of organ injury, infection and toxicity.

text.zh-CN: 查清首发症状与病程
text.en: Establish presenting symptoms and course

text.zh-CN: 补充伴随症状及相关病史
text.en: Elicit associated symptoms and relevant background

text.zh-CN: 明确过敏资料的证据边界
text.en: Establish the evidence boundary for allergy information

text.zh-CN: 核对与当前表现相关的体征
text.en: Review signs relevant to the presentation

text.zh-CN: 调阅早期关键检查
text.en: Review the key early investigations

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确整合早期证据
text.en: Integrate the early evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 核对后续验证资料
text.en: Review subsequent corroborating evidence

text.zh-CN: 首次正确说明后续证据的强度和边界
text.en: State the strength and limits of subsequent evidence correctly on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次即选择兼顾器官威胁与感染风险的多学科计划
text.en: Choose a multidisciplinary plan balancing organ threat and infection risk on the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 复盘原报告治疗及转归
text.en: Review reported treatment and outcome

text.zh-CN: 清楚说明证据与不确定性
text.en: Explain evidence and uncertainty clearly

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：肾脏线索使单纯肺感染解释不充分。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：MPO/PR3特异抗体、完整感染排查、活检、氧合数值及长期复发和治疗毒性。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Renal clues make a lung-infection-only explanation insufficient. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: MPO/PR3-specific antibodies, complete infection evaluation, biopsy, oxygenation values and long-term relapse/toxicity. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 报告临床诊断显微镜下多血管炎，依据肺肾表现、动态ANCA及治疗后变化，未有活检确证。
conclusion.en: The report clinically diagnosed microscopic polyangiitis from pulmonary–renal findings, evolving ANCA and response, without biopsy confirmation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 肾脏线索使单纯肺感染解释不充分。
keyReasoning.en: Renal clues make a lung-infection-only explanation insufficient.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 初次阴性与后续阳性应按时间记录。
keyReasoning.en: Initial negative and later positive tests must remain in sequence.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗反应支持判断但不能替代缺失的组织学证据。
keyReasoning.en: Response supports interpretation but does not replace missing histology.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 将血痰与尿异常作为跨器官线索。
teachingPoints.en: Connect blood-streaked sputum with urinary abnormalities.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不把血清学阴性理解为绝对排除。
teachingPoints.en: Do not treat negative serology as absolute exclusion.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 明确临床诊断和病理确诊的不同。
teachingPoints.en: Distinguish clinical diagnosis from pathological confirmation.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

testUtterances.text: 这一阵咳嗽发烧持续多久？
How long has this episode of cough and fever lasted?
咳痰和畏寒是什么时候开始的？
When did sputum and chills begin?
下午晚上是不是更烧？
Is the fever worse in the afternoon or evening?
最高烧到多少，什么时候烧？
How high does the fever get, and at what time?
吃药打针后咳嗽发热好些了吗？
Did medicines or infusions improve the cough and fever?
抗结核治疗后症状有没有缓解？
Did symptoms improve with tuberculosis treatment?

什么时候开始痰中带血？
When did blood-streaking first appear?

What was health like before this illness?
既往有没有需要治疗的疾病？
Were any earlier illnesses treated?

What previous thyroid problem was there?

平时是否服甲状腺药？
